name: WakandaDB
tagline: 4D's object datastore with server-side JavaScript and REST at the core of the Wakanda platform; discontinued.
description: WakandaDB was the object datastore inside Wakanda, a full-stack JavaScript platform that came out of the French company 4D and was developed by Wakanda SAS. Developers defined datastore classes and relations, then worked with them through a server-side JavaScript engine (with stored procedures and triggers) and an automatic RESTful API, while Wakanda Studio and a client framework handled the UI. It was dual-licensed under AGPLv3 and a commercial licence. The last listed release is 2.7.0 (April 29, 2019), after which development stopped; wakanda.io now redirects to 4D's website. Treat it as discontinued and plan migrations accordingly.
statusNote: No release since 2.7.0 (April 2019); wakanda.io now redirects to 4D's site and the Wakanda GitHub org is inactive.

pricing.notes: Community edition under AGPLv3; commercial licences and support were sold.

strengths: Datastore classes with relations exposed automatically over REST
One language (JavaScript) from database logic to browser
Integrated IDE and UI framework for quick business apps
weaknesses: Proprietary APIs make migration a rewrite
useCases: Maintaining or migrating legacy Wakanda apps
